Subject: Intro call recap — security & procurement checkpoints

Hi Emma / Tom,

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned: 

Summary of what we heard
- Goal: run a 4-week pilot integrating Redwood inference into StellarDx’s triage pipeline (API-only, no PHI persisted).
- Decision makers: engineering + security + procurement. Emma is coordinating procurement/security; Tom is the technical lead.
- Primary asks: SOC 2 report, pen test highlights, audit log access details, and a procurement T&C checklist.

Immediate next steps (from our side)
1) I’ll send a short package with SOC 2 summary + pen-test highlights and answers to three quick questions about retention/audit logs (by EOD Monday).
2) We’ll propose a mutual action plan (MAP) that maps owners and dates for procurement + security items.
3) Please share the procurement contact and an initial target budget/contract cadence if you have it.

Open questions we need from you
- Who is the economic buyer (name + role + email)?
- Target procurement timeline for signing (weeks)?
- Any non-negotiable legal clauses (data residency, export controls)?

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the package Monday.

—

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 17:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro call recap — security & procurement checkpoints

Emma — thanks, copying Monica (CS lead) so she sees the timeline. Attached is the 1-page SOC 2 summary and a short pen-test highlights doc. Below are the quick answers to the three items you flagged.

Attachments (attached to this email):
- SOC2_summary_2025.pdf (pdf) — scope: security + availability; attestation date: 2025-11-03; auditor: NorthBridge LLP.
- pen_test_highlights_2026.txt (text) — summary of high/medium/low findings and mitigation status.

Quick answers:
- Hosted segmentation: In Redwood hosted API we logically separate tenant data; no customer data is mixed. For customers requiring stronger isolation we offer Dedicated pools or Private deployment. Details are summarized in SOC2_summary_2025.pdf.
- Pen test: No open high findings; two medium items (dependency updates, and an auth token expiry policy) which are scheduled fixes — see pen_test_highlights_2026.txt for dates.
- Audit logs & retention: Audit logs are available via an API and can be exported to customer S3 or pushed to your SIEM (Splunk/Datadog). Default retention in hosted is 90 days; we can extend retention on Dedicated/Private deployments per contract.

Proposed MAP (mutual action plan) — condensed:
- Week 0 (this week): Share security package (done).
- Week 1: Test account creation + API keys (Redwood) — owner: Tom (StellarDx).
- Week 2: Pilot integration (engineering) — owner: Tom + Redwood integration engineer (Monica).
- Week 3: Security review + procurement checklist (security + procurement).
- Week 4: Pilot assessment + decision (Marcus).

Action items for Emma / StellarDx:
- Please confirm Marcus’ availability for a 30-minute decision sync in the week of Jan 18.
- Add Sarah Lin to thread to start procurement paperwork.

If it helps, I can push a short DocuSign-friendly PO template and a sample contract summary for legal to review.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0122
